name: expandable

frames.best_why: The card is fully expanded with the title, description and all three status rows in view.

tagline: A Quick Actions card springs open to show three status rows.
summary: A compact card that expands on click to reveal a list of status checks, with a chevron that flips and a Show more or Show less link at the bottom.
appearance: A dark rounded card holds a small zap icon, the title Quick Actions, a grey subtitle and a downward chevron, with one line of copy and a Show more link. Expanded, the same card is taller and wider with three dot-marked status rows.
behaviour: Clicking the chevron or the Show more link springs the card to its larger size and slides the status rows up into view; clicking again collapses it back.
demo_content: Quick Actions card with status lines Feature enabled and running, 3 integrations connected, 1 pending review.
search_phrases: card that expands to show more details
quick actions panel with show more
info card with hidden status rows
toggle card open for extra options
use_when: A small summary card hides a short list of details that only some users need to open.
avoid_when: It reflows layout when opened and has a fixed collapsed width, so it is awkward inside tight grids.
customise: Collapsed and expanded sizes, hover-to-expand, delays and animation presets are props or subcomponent options; card copy is passed as children.
weight_why: One card and a few status rows animated with springs, only on toggle.

a11y.note: The trigger works from the keyboard but never exposes aria-expanded, and both triggers share the same Toggle expand label.

issues: Neither trigger reports aria-expanded, so screen readers cannot tell the state.
The chevron and the Show more link share the same Toggle expand label.
polish_why: Spring and chevron flip read well; otherwise a plain card with a hidden list.
title: Expandable
